description: MALAI: Look up nutrition for a food in MALAI's database (USDA FoodData Central, US foods): calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, saturated fat and sugar per serving (or per 100 g), plus the share of calories from protein. Use for "how much protein is in cottage cheese", "compare tofu and chicken", "is a turkey sandwich high in protein". A null value means unknown, not zero. Don't use to log food (that needs a MALAI account: malai_how_to_connect).
name: malai_search_foods

nutrition.description: calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, saturated_fat_g, sugar_g; null = unknown.

per.description: The amount the nutrition is for, e.g. "0.5 cup (113 g)" or "100 g".

title: Food nutrition lookup
